blurb: Guests fish the pristine flats and backwater mangrove shorelines around Clearwater and Tampa Bay targeting snook, redfish, trout, and tarpon. Trips include fishing gear, bait, tackle, fishing license, fish cleaning and bagging. Tarpon fishing is available May through July and offers a chance to catch large trophy tarpon.

quotes.author: Mike C.
quotes.text: Brian is great to talk to and a master at hunting down big fish! We caught close to 20 fish (Trout, Redfish, and Pompano) in four hours. He was great with my 8 year old son and made sure he caught as many fish as the rest of us. We have had some cold December and January weather and he communicated with us early to let us know the situation and even allowed us push out the trip a couple weeks for better fishing weather. If you are looking for a charter with the family, this is the boat for you. The memories we made are priceless and we will definitely be booking with him again soon. Mike C.

quotes.author: Angie B.
quotes.text: We took a glorious trip with Clearwater Inshore Fishing! Met at the boat on a blue sky day and kids and adults had an amazing time! We caught fish for dinner that was delicious and caught fish as well that were tossed back in. Being Inshore was nice since it did not take long to get to and yet did not take away from our half-day trip. We will definitely try it again! You should too! They were responsive, responsible and very nice to be with at this Fishing boat! Angie B.

quotes.author: Kim B.
quotes.text: Outstanding day of fishing! What an amazing day! Captain Brian is absolutely wonderful and so knowledgeable. I brought my niece (12) and nephew (9) for a fishing trip and we caught about 20 fish in 4 hours! Oh, and one shark! Both kids had a Inshore Slam – caught a trout, a snook and a red fish – and they couldn’t be more excited or proud! From start to finish we all had an outstanding time and I can’t recommend Captain Brian and Clearwater Inshore Fishing enough. Kim B.

quotes.author: Michael G.
quotes.text: I’ve gone out twice with Brian in recent weeks, both were great experiences. On one trip we had a family of 5 with limited fishing experience for some of the group, he managed everything exceptionally well. Everyone had a great time and caught many fish. Brian knows what he is doing and is always working to get you in the right spot, and helping to bring the fish in. I would definitely recommend him, and would go out again with Clearwater Inshore Fishing. Michael G.

quotes.author: Sara R.
quotes.text: Best Fishing Experience, highly recommend. Brian is the BEST! Family of 4 with two teen children. Everyone caught multiple fish. We couldn’t get the lines in fast enough. The entire experience was awesome and lots of great memories made!! Brian is friendly, knowledgeable and great with the kids. We’ll be back no question. Definitely recommend! Sara R.

quotes.author: Larry L.
quotes.text: I highly recommend Brian, my son and I went today and caught a lot of quality fish. I have tried numerous guides all around for trophy reds and snook and Brian kept us on them. I can’t say enough. He explained and worked with my son the whole trip and took time to teach him methods and the whys of how we fished. Excellent. Larry L.
